name: 7-Zip
description: 7-Zip is a file archiver with high compression ratios that supports many archive formats. It is released under the LGPL.

name: A Note
description: Lightweight desktop sticky notes app with colored notes, fonts, alarms and docking to screen edges. Open source (GPL) with no ads or paid tiers.
notes: UNCERTAIN: the standalone project's own site could not be verified; official_url is the PortableApps entry (third party). PortableApps lists App License: Open Source (GPL) and release 4.2.4 (2013-01-05). URL note: original developer site is gone; PortableApps.com (co-publisher, GPL source linked) is the maintained distribution and serves as the primary download.

name: Angry IP Scanner
description: Fast cross-platform IP address and port scanner, released under the GPLv2. Some antivirus products flag it because it performs network scans.

name: Apache OpenOffice
description: Full open-source office suite (Apache License 2.0) with Writer, Calc, Impress, Draw, Base and Math. Actively released (4.1.16, Nov 2025) and free for any purpose including commercial use.
notes: Project strongly warns users to download only from the official site. Also listed in the Microsoft Store for selected languages; could not verify a stable store URL so no alt added.

name: AutoHotkey
description: Scripting language for Windows automation (GPLv2). Creates hotkeys, text expansions, macros and small utilities.

name: Autoruns
description: Freeware Sysinternals tool that shows every program configured to start automatically with Windows and lets you disable entries. It covers the registry, startup folders, services, drivers and scheduled tasks.

name: BabelPad
description: Unicode text editor and word processor by Andrew West with full Unicode character support. Free for personal and commercial use, fully featured, single executable with no installer, no ads or in-app purchases.
notes: Author asks users to download only from babelstone.co.uk and does not support third-party distributions. Verified free for commercial use on the official page.

name: Balabolka
description: Freeware text-to-speech program that reads documents aloud using installed Windows voices and can save speech to audio files. It supports many file formats, custom dictionaries and pronunciation rules.
notes: Donations are accepted; the separate paid product Cross+A is unrelated to the free Balabolka.

name: Bitwarden Desktop
description: Password manager with end-to-end encrypted sync across devices. Core features are free; a Bitwarden account is required.
free_enough_reason: paid Premium adds extras such as file storage and TOTP, but the free tier covers unlimited items and sync.

name: Blank And Secure
description: Portable file shredder from SoftwareOK. Overwrites files with random data and can wipe free disk space. Donations are accepted but no nagging is reported.

name: BleachBit
description: Open source privacy cleaner (GPL-3.0) that deletes caches, temp files, cookies and history from browsers and the system. It has no ads, accounts or paid tier.

name: Blender
description: Blender is a 3D creation suite for modeling, animation, rendering and video editing. It is developed by the Blender Foundation and released under the GPL.

name: BOINC
description: Open-source middleware for volunteer computing (LGPL). Donate idle CPU time to research projects such as disease and climate science.
notes: UNCERTAIN: no taxonomy basket fits distributed computing; kept input placement System/Automate.

name: Cherrytree
description: Hierarchical note-taking app (GPLv3) storing rich text, images, tables, links and code snippets in a single file, with password protection. Actively maintained by Giuseppe Penone.
notes: UNCERTAIN: official site URL — sources cite both giuspen.net/cherrytree and giuspen.com/cherrytree; used the most recent citation (giuspen.net). GitHub repo giuspen/cherrytree confirms open source.

name: Chromium
description: Open-source browser project maintained by Google. It is the upstream code base behind Chrome, Edge, Opera and other Chromium-based browsers.

name: ClamWin
description: Windows front end for the ClamAV antivirus engine, released under the GPL.
notes: UNCERTAIN: bundled engine is 0.103.2.1 (stale since 2021-06); an unverified third-party claim says ClamAV blocks database updates for engines at or below 0.105, which would leave it unable to fetch current signatures. Could not verify.

name: Coreinfo
description: Freeware Sysinternals command-line utility that maps logical processors to physical cores, NUMA nodes, sockets and caches. Actively maintained (v4.0, Dec 2025).

name: CPU-Z
description: Freeware system profiler by CPUID that reports detailed information about the CPU, motherboard, memory and graphics. The free edition is complete with no paid version.
notes: Caution: CPUID's site suffered a watering-hole compromise on Apr 9-10 2026 that served trojanized CPU-Z 2.19 and HWMonitor installers; fixed since. Download only from cpuid.com and verify SHA256 checksums.

name: CpuFrequenz
description: Freeware tool by SoftwareOK that shows CPU load and clock frequency in real time with a load graph and a precise frequency determination mode. Actively maintained (v4.55, Apr 2026).

name: Cryptomator
description: Client-side encryption for cloud folders. Creates encrypted vaults that sync through any cloud provider; open source under the GPLv3.

name: CrystalDiskInfo
description: Open source disk health monitor that reads S.M.A.R.T. data and shows drive temperature, error counts and overall health status. It is MIT licensed with no paid tier.

name: CrystalDiskMark
description: Open source disk benchmark that measures sequential and random read and write speeds of storage devices. It is MIT licensed and fully functional with no paid tier.

name: CrystalMark Retro
description: Open source benchmark (GPL) by Crystal Dew World that measures CPU, disk, 2D and 3D performance with one click on Windows 95 through 11. The full benchmark runs locally with no account needed.
notes: Submitting scores to the optional CrystalMarkDB comparison site requires a free account; the benchmark itself needs none.

name: Daphne
description: Open source process manager (GPL, source published on the author's site) that can kill, debug and control windows, with drag-over-window targeting, always-on-top rules and process traps. Latest release v2.04 (2014); the official site now lists it under legacy.
notes: Project is archived/legacy but functional. Per the author, the installers offer no third-party software and the app is free of charge.

name: DebugView
description: Freeware Sysinternals tool that captures debug output (OutputDebugString and DbgPrint) from drivers and programs in real time. Latest release v4.90 (2019); functional and unmaintained.

name: Dicom
description: Word completion tool that pops up word suggestions after a few keystrokes, reducing typing effort for users with motor and coordination impairments. It ships with English and French dictionaries and custom word lists.
notes: UNCERTAIN: PortableApps and AlternativeTo describe Dicom as open source, but no specific OSI license or source repo could be verified. UNCERTAIN: developer Icom Provence's own site could not be found; the PortableApps page above is the sanctioned distribution.

name: Disk Cleaner
description: Open source (GPL) junk-file cleaner by R.J. Moerland that removes temp files, caches and histories. The project site diskcleaner.nl redirects to its SourceForge page.

name: DiskMon
description: Freeware Sysinternals utility that captures hard disk activity and displays it like a software disk activity light in the system tray. It is a tiny standalone executable from Microsoft.

name: Don't Sleep
description: Freeware tool by SoftwareOK that prevents the PC from sleeping, shutting down, hibernating or restarting, with timer-based rules. Free for personal and business use.

name: DSpeech
description: Freeware text-to-speech tool by Dimio that reads clipboard text or documents aloud through Windows voices. It is free for personal and commercial use.

name: DSynchronize
description: DSynchronize is a folder synchronization tool from Dimio. It is freeware, free for personal and business use.

name: DTaskManager
description: Freeware task manager by Dimio with batch process termination, process suspend/resume and forced kill of stubborn processes. Actively maintained (v1.57.32, Oct 2025).
notes: Free for personal and business use per PortableApps, packaged with the publisher's permission.

name: Duplicate Files Finder
description: Duplicate Files Finder from MindGems scans drives for duplicate files so they can be removed. It is freeware.
free_enough_reason: The free tier fully finds and deletes duplicate files; the Pro version only adds fuzzy search and related extras.

name: Duplicati
description: Duplicati is an encrypted backup client that stores incremental backups on cloud storage and remote servers. It is released under the MIT license; the commercial Duplicati, Inc. sells managed services, not the client.

name: Emsisoft Emergency Kit
description: Portable on-demand malware scanner and remover. Free for personal use; no installation needed.

name: Eraser Classic
description: Secure file erasure tool for Windows. Overwrites files, folders and free space to standards such as DoD 5220.22-M; released under the GPL.
notes: Eraser 6.x is a .NET rewrite of the Classic 5.x line; both ship from the same project and download page.

name: Eraser .Net
description: The .NET (6.x) rewrite of the Eraser secure file erasure tool for Windows, under the same GPL license.
notes: Eraser 6.x is a .NET rewrite of the Classic 5.x line; both ship from the same project and download page.

name: EraserDrop
description: Portable drag-and-drop secure file shredder by Erik Pilsits. Drop files on its floating icon to shred them.
notes: last release 2.1.1 (2012); could not verify the developer's site; distributed via PortableApps.com.

name: Everything
description: Everything is a file and folder search tool from voidtools that returns results as you type. It is freeware; donations are optional and all features work without paying.

name: Explorer++
description: Explorer++ is a tabbed, dual-pane file manager for Windows. It is released under GPL-3.0-only; version 1.4.0 is current.

name: Falkon
description: Lightweight web browser built on QtWebEngine and maintained by the KDE project. It runs on Windows, Linux and macOS.

name: FanControl
description: Freeware fan control tool by Remi Mercier (Rem0o) that builds custom fan curves from temperature sensors for CPU, GPU and case fans. It is free for personal, non-commercial use.
notes: Not open source despite the GitHub distribution; the upstream license is proprietary freeware for personal, non-commercial use. No paid tier. The project also runs an official site at getfancontrol.com.

name: FastCopy
description: FastCopy is a file copy and delete utility. It is freeware; personal use is free while some commercial use may require a paid license.
notes: UNCERTAIN: the current EULA on fastcopy.jp was not verified; pendriveapps reports personal-use-free with a paid license for some commercial use.

name: FeedRoller
description: RSS feed ticker that scrolls headlines across the desktop. The original site is offline and the program is distributed via PortableApps.com.
notes: original site offline; PortableApps.com hosts a build; could not verify an official download page.

name: File Converter
description: File Converter adds file conversion and compression presets to the Windows Explorer context menu. It is a personal open source project released under the GPLv3.

name: FileOptimizer
description: FileOptimizer reduces file sizes without changing their formats and supports many file types. It is released under the AGPL-3.0.
notes: UNCERTAIN: portablefreeware.com reports an optional startup ad screen that can be disabled — could not verify it only promotes the developer's own support message.

name: FileVoyager
description: FileVoyager is a dual-pane file manager with tabs and a preview pane. It is freeware; version 25.12.5 is current.

name: FileZilla
description: FTP, FTPS and SFTP client released under the GPL. No ads, trials or bundled offers in the official build.
free_enough_reason: paid FileZilla Pro adds cloud-storage protocols, but the free client is a complete FTP/SFTP product.

name: Finance Explorer
description: Finance Explorer is a personal finance and budgeting application from Metalogic Software. It is freeware for personal and business use.
notes: Publisher site is offline; the PortableApps release page is used as the download source (PortableApps notes the package is made available directly from the publisher).

name: FocusWriter
description: Distraction-free full-screen text editor with hide-away controls, themes, daily writing goals and live statistics. Free and open source (GPL) by Graeme Gott, actively released (1.9.0, Feb 2026).
notes: Sources conflict slightly on GPL version (Wikipedia says GPL-2.0-or-later, LinuxLinks says GPLv3.0); repo is github.com/gottcode/focuswriter. URL scheme (https) assumed from the cited domain; could not verify exact canonical form.

name: Folding@home
description: Distributed computing project that uses idle PC power for biomedical research. No account needed to start; the client is open source.
notes: UNCERTAIN: no taxonomy basket fits distributed computing; kept input placement System/Automate.

name: Free Download Manager
description: Download manager that splits downloads into segments and integrates with browsers. The site calls it open source but no OSI license could be found, so it is recorded as freeware.

name: FreeCAD
description: FreeCAD is a parametric 3D CAD modeler aimed at mechanical engineering and product design. It is released under the LGPL-2.1.

name: FreeCommander
description: FreeCommander is a dual-pane orthodox file manager with tabs and built-in viewers. It is freeware, free for personal and commercial use.

name: FreeFileSync
description: FreeFileSync is a folder comparison and synchronization tool. It is released under the GPLv3.
notes: UNCERTAIN: the official FAQ says the standard and Donation editions are personal-use-only (businesses need the Business Edition); third parties report occasional donation prompts, not verified as nagging.

name: FUPX
description: FUPX is a compressor frontend from gurupia based on UPX for shrinking executables. It is freeware; version 3.2 is current.

name: GeekUninstaller
description: Freeware uninstaller by Thomas Koen that removes programs completely, including leftover files and registry traces, with forced removal for broken installs. Actively maintained (v1.5.5.185, Sep 2026).
free_enough_reason: The free edition uninstalls programs and removes leftover files and registry traces with no ads or nags; Pro adds batch uninstall and forced uninstall.

name: GnuCash
description: GnuCash is a double-entry accounting program for personal and small-business finances. It is released under the GPL.

name: Google Chrome
description: Google's web browser. It is free of charge but proprietary, and it sends usage and crash data to Google unless disabled; syncing needs a Google account.
notes: data-collection flag: usage and crash reporting is on by default; core browsing needs no account.

name: Gopherus
description: Console client for browsing Gopherspace, maintained as open source on SourceForge.

name: GPG Plugin
description: PortableApps add-on that packages GnuPG for encrypting and signing files. Not a standalone application.
notes: a PortableApps add-on packaging GnuPG, not a standalone app; could not verify an official download page.

name: GPU-Z
description: Freeware graphics profiler by TechPowerUp that reports detailed GPU specifications, clock speeds, temperatures and sensor readings. There is no paid version and donations are optional.
notes: Free for personal and commercial use per the TechPowerUp license.

name: HDHacker
description: Freeware tool by Dimio that saves and restores the master boot record and boot sectors of disks. Latest release is v1.6.2 from July 2017; unmaintained but functional.

name: HijackThis
description: System scanner that lists browser hijack and autostart changes for manual review. The original Trend Micro release ended in 2013; the maintained community fork is by dragokas.
notes: point users at the dragokas fork, not the abandoned Trend Micro build.

name: HomeBank
description: HomeBank is a personal accounting application for managing accounts, budgets and reports. It is released under the GPLv2.

name: HWiNFO
description: Hardware information and monitoring tool that reports detailed sensor data for CPU, GPU, memory, drives and mainboard components. It includes real-time monitoring, logging and reporting.
free_enough_reason: HWiNFO64 is a complete monitoring and reporting product for non-commercial use; the ~$29 Pro adds commercial licensing, remote monitoring and priority support.
notes: Free for non-commercial use since v7.00; commercial use requires the Pro license.

name: HWMonitor
description: Freeware hardware monitor by CPUID that reads voltages, temperatures, fan speeds and power sensors in an expandable tree view.
free_enough_reason: The free version covers complete local sensor monitoring; the paid Pro adds remote monitoring, logging and graphing.
notes: Caution: CPUID's site suffered a watering-hole compromise on Apr 9-10 2026 that served trojanized CPU-Z 2.19 and HWMonitor installers; fixed since. Download only from cpuid.com and verify SHA256 checksums. UNCERTAIN: reported as freeware for non-commercial use by abit.ee; CPUID's own license terms were not re-verified in this pass.

name: Inkscape
description: Inkscape is a vector graphics editor for illustrations, icons and diagrams. It is released under the GPL-2.0 or later.

name: Iron
description: Chromium-based browser from SRWare that strips out some Google tracking components.
notes: batch hint said oss but no source repository or OSI license statement was found, so it is recorded as freeware.

name: Joplin
description: Free and open-source (AGPL) note-taking and to-do app with Markdown notes, end-to-end encrypted sync to a target of your choice, plugins and web clipper.
free_enough_reason: Paid Joplin Cloud sync service exists, but the app is complete offline-first software and syncs free to local folders, Dropbox, OneDrive, WebDAV or a self-hosted Joplin Server.
notes: No account needed for core features; a Joplin Cloud account is only needed if using that optional paid sync service. Self-hosted Joplin Server is free for non-commercial use.

name: K-Meleon
description: Lightweight Windows browser built on the Goanna engine, in the spirit of classic Mozilla.

name: Kanri
description: Kanri is an offline kanban board application for organizing projects and to-dos. It is released under the GPL-3.0 and saw active development through 2026.

name: Kaspersky TDSSKiller
description: Portable rootkit scanner and remover from Kaspersky.
notes: could not verify a direct download page; Kaspersky tools have regional availability limits in some jurisdictions.

name: KeePass Classic
description: Password manager (1.x branch) storing logins in an encrypted local database.

name: KeePass Professional
description: Password manager (2.x branch) storing logins in an encrypted local database.

name: KeePassXC
description: Community fork of KeePass with a modern interface for Windows, macOS and Linux.

name: KiCad
description: KiCad is an electronic design automation suite for schematic capture and PCB layout. It is released under the GPL-3.0.

name: KiTTY
description: Fork of the PuTTY SSH and telnet client with extra session management features, released under the MIT license.

name: Kudu
description: Open source PC maintenance suite (MIT) that cleans junk files, manages startup items and uninstalls programs. The desktop app is complete without donating or subscribing.
free_enough_reason: The desktop app is a complete MIT-licensed maintenance suite with no ads or upsells; the $5/device/month Kudu Cloud only adds optional remote monitoring.
notes: Source repo: github.com/AdventDevInc/kudu.

name: Lagrange
description: Desktop client for browsing Gopher and Gemini content with a modern interface. Open source and actively developed.

name: LibreCAD
description: LibreCAD is a 2D CAD application for technical drawings and plans. It is released under the GPLv2.

name: LibreOffice
description: Open-source (MPL-2.0) full office suite from The Document Foundation with Writer, Calc, Impress, Draw, Base and Math. Actively released (26.8.1, Oct 2026) with no licensing fees and no vendor lock-in.
notes: Enterprise ecosystem editions with SLAs exist from third-party companies, but the community release itself is fully free with no paid tier, so free_enough is false.

name: LibreWolf
description: Privacy-focused fork of Firefox with telemetry removed and tracking protections hardened by default.

name: Links
description: Text and graphics-mode web browser that runs in the terminal or a simple GUI on Windows, Linux and other systems.

name: LocalSend
description: Cross-platform local file sharing (AirDrop-like) over Wi-Fi with no account and no cloud. Open source under the Apache 2.0 license.

name: Logseq
description: Privacy-first open-source (AGPL-3.0) personal knowledge base with graph view, Markdown and org-mode support and local-first data storage. Actively maintained by Logseq Inc.
free_enough_reason: A paid Logseq Sync service exists, but the app is a complete local-first knowledge base that stores notes as local Markdown or org-mode files and syncs fine without it.
notes: No account needed for core features; paid sync is optional.

name: Lynx
description: Classic text-mode web browser for the command line, maintained as open source since 1992.

name: Maxthon
description: Web browser from Maxthon Technology with built-in ad blocking and cloud sync. Free to use.

name: Microsoft Safety Scanner
description: Microsoft's on-demand portable malware scanner. Each download expires 10 days after download and can be re-downloaded free.
notes: expires 10 days after download; re-download is free.

name: Money Manager Ex
description: Money Manager Ex is a personal finance manager with budgeting, reporting and multi-currency support. It is released under the GPL.

name: Mozilla Firefox Developer Edition
description: Developer edition of Firefox with experimental tools and a separate release channel, under the same MPL 2.0 license.

name: Mozilla Firefox
description: Web browser from Mozilla, released under the Mozilla Public License 2.0.

name: NanaZip
description: NanaZip is a 7-Zip fork with a modern Windows interface, dark mode and MSIX packaging. Its own code is MIT licensed; the 7-Zip-derived code keeps the 7-Zip license. Actively developed; 7.0 released 2026.

name: Notes
description: Fast, private Qt-based note-taking app by nuttyartist with Markdown support, folders, tags, themes and a Markdown-to-Kanban board. Fully open source and cross-platform, tracks nothing.
free_enough_reason: A paid Pro license exists but only unlocks editing inside the Kanban view and a year of Pro updates; the free app is otherwise complete, and all Pro features are available free by building from source.
notes: Could not verify the exact OSI license identifier (README asserts fully open source); repo is github.com/nuttyartist/notes.

name: NVDA
description: Free and open source screen reader by NV Access that provides spoken and braille feedback for blind and low-vision users. It is GPL-2-or-later licensed and donation-funded.

name: O&O ShutUp10++
description: Portable tool that exposes Windows 10/11 privacy and telemetry settings as toggles with safety recommendations.
free_enough_reason: paid ShutUp10 Premium exists, but the free edition applies all privacy toggles; Premium only automates re-applying them after Windows updates.

name: On-Screen Keyboard
description: PortableApps launcher for the built-in Windows on-screen keyboard that carries settings like hover-to-select and always-on-top from PC to PC. It gives quick access to the system keyboard for accessibility and alternate text entry.
notes: This is a PortableApps launcher for the built-in Windows OSK, not a standalone keyboard app.

name: OneLoupe
description: Portable screen magnifier by SoftwareOK that zooms into the area of the screen around the mouse cursor. It runs without installation and is free for personal and business use.

name: Opera GX
description: Gaming-oriented variant of the Opera browser with CPU, RAM and network limiters.
free_enough_reason: paid VPN Pro and AI upgrades exist, but the free browser is complete with no ads, trials or feature gating.
notes: data-collection flag: sync and AI features send data to Opera; core browsing works without an account.

name: Opera
description: Chromium-based web browser with a built-in sidebar, Flow sync and optional VPN.
free_enough_reason: paid VPN Pro and AI upgrades exist, but the free browser is complete with no ads, trials or feature gating.
notes: data-collection flag: sync and AI features send data to Opera; core browsing works without an account.

name: Otter Browser
description: Qt-based browser that recreates the classic Opera 12 interface, maintained as open source.

name: Password Safe
description: Password manager originally designed by Bruce Schneier. Stores logins in an encrypted database file; source under the Artistic License 2.0.

name: PCI-Z
description: Freeware utility by Bruno Banelli that identifies PCI and PCI-E devices, including unknown ones, using the public PCI ID repository. It is a single portable executable; latest release v2.0 (2017), unmaintained but functional.
notes: Free for business and personal use per PortableApps.

name: PeaZip
description: PeaZip is a file archiver and manager that supports many archive formats. It is released under the LGPLv3.

name: PeerBlock
description: IP filter that blocks connections to and from blacklisted address ranges.
notes: UNCERTAIN: dormant since 2014; could not verify it works on Windows 10/11.

name: Pencil2D
description: Pencil2D is a hand-drawn 2D animation and drawing application. It is released under the GPL-2.0.

name: PNotes.NET
description: PNotes.NET is the .NET-based successor to PNotes, a desktop sticky-notes application. Its project page lists the GPLv2 as its license.
notes: UNCERTAIN: the standalone license file could not be located; the SourceForge project umbrella lists GPLv2. Last release 3.8.2.2 (Nov 2021).

name: PNotes
description: PNotes is a desktop sticky-notes application with scheduling and customization options. It is released under the GPLv2.

name: PortableApps.com AppCompactor
description: AppCompactor compresses application folders to reduce their disk footprint. It is open source; version 3.17 released 2026-06-29.
notes: UNCERTAIN: the exact PortableApps app-page URL was not captured verbatim, so the PortableApps.com domain root is used; version 3.17 released 2026-06-29 per PortableApps news.

name: PortExpert
description: Port monitor from KC Softwares showing which applications use TCP and UDP connections, with WhoIs lookup. Freeware for personal and business use.
notes: UNCERTAIN: could not verify the current download page; third-party reviews note the standard installer bundles a declinable third-party offer (RelevantKnowledge) - use the Lite build, which ships without sponsors; AlternativeTo flags the project discontinued while other catalogs show a 2026 update.

name: PrivaZer
description: Freeware privacy cleaner that removes traces of computer and internet activity and can securely erase files. The free version is complete and donation-funded with no nag screens.
free_enough_reason: The free version is a complete cleaner with no nagware; the $10+ Donors version adds early access to updates and extra features.
notes: Flagged row given extra scrutiny: no bundled offers, no persistent upgrade nagging and no ads found; the donation prompt is a single optional dialog. Free for personal use; the Donors version is aimed at commercial users.

name: Process Explorer
description: Freeware Sysinternals task manager replacement showing which files, registry keys and DLLs each process has open, with a tree view and per-process details. A standard diagnostic tool.

name: Process Hacker
description: Open source advanced task manager (GPL-3.0) for monitoring processes, services, network connections and memory in depth.
notes: Process Hacker was renamed to System Informer; this row and the System Informer row cover the same project.

name: Process Monitor
description: Freeware Sysinternals tool that logs file system, registry, process and network activity in real time with powerful filtering. The essential Windows troubleshooting utility.

name: ProcessKO
description: Freeware process killer by SoftwareOK that terminates or restarts hanging processes from the system tray, with favorites and an automatic KO timer. Actively maintained (v6.77, Jul 2026).

name: PuTTY
description: SSH, telnet and serial client for Windows and Unix, released under the MIT license.

name: Q-Dir
description: Q-Dir is a quad-pane file manager from SoftwareOK. It is freeware.

name: qBittorrent Enhanced
description: Community fork of qBittorrent with extra anti-leech and blocking features, under the same GPLv2 license.

name: qBittorrent
description: BitTorrent client released under the GPLv2 with no ads, trials or bundled offers.

name: QOwnNotes
description: Plain-text Markdown note-taking app (GPL-2.0-only) storing notes as local files, with tags, scripting, optional AES-256 encryption and Nextcloud/ownCloud integration. Actively maintained by Patrizio Bekerle.
notes: Sync is handled externally (e.g. Nextcloud client); no account required for core features.

name: QuickMemoryTestOK
description: Freeware RAM tester by SoftwareOK that quickly checks memory for errors and displays module details like manufacturer, serial number and clock frequency. Actively maintained (v5.41, Mar 2026).

name: QuiteRSS
description: RSS and Atom feed reader for Windows and Linux. Development is quiet (last stable 2020) but the released build still works.
notes: UNCERTAIN: dormant since 2020; could not verify the last release works on Windows 11.

name: QwikMark
description: Freeware single-screen benchmark by Vista Software that tests CPU, memory and disk throughput in one window. The project was abandoned at v0.4 (2012) but remains functional.
notes: UNCERTAIN: the author's own site no longer offers the download; PortableApps is the working source and the URL above is their distribution page rather than the developer's site.

name: RAMMap
description: Freeware Sysinternals tool that analyzes physical memory usage across tabs like Use Counts, Processes and File Summary. It shows exactly how Windows allocates RAM.

name: Recuva
description: Freeware file recovery tool by Piriform (Gen Digital) that restores deleted files from disks, USB drives and memory cards with a step-by-step wizard.
free_enough_reason: The free edition recovers unlimited data; the paid Professional adds virtual hard drive support, automatic updates and premium support.
notes: Free for home use only; commercial use needs a paid license. UNCERTAIN: Piriform installers for sibling products bundle opt-out third-party offers; could not verify whether the current Recuva installer still does.

name: RedNotebook
description: Desktop journal and diary (GPL) with calendar navigation, tags, templates, spell check and export to plain text, HTML, LaTeX or PDF. Data stored in plain-text files. Actively released (2.43, Oct 2026).
notes: PortableApps lists an old RedNotebook Portable (1.15.0, 2017); current releases come from the official site, so no alt added.

name: RegAlyzer
description: Freeware registry editor by Safer-Networking with advanced search, bookmarks, favorites and registry comparison features.
notes: UNCERTAIN: could not fully verify the current standalone download status of RegAlyzer 2 RC on the Safer-Networking site.

name: Regshot
description: Open source snapshot tool that compares registry and file system states before and after changes to show exactly what an installer modified. The maintained GitHub fork states MIT; SourceForge lists LGPL-2.0.
notes: License text discrepancy between the fork (MIT) and SourceForge (LGPLv2); both are OSI licenses.

name: RSS Guard
description: Actively developed open-source RSS reader for Windows, Linux and macOS.

name: Rufus
description: Open source utility that creates bootable USB drives from ISO images for Windows and Linux installs. It is GPL-3.0 licensed and runs as a single portable executable.

name: Run-Command
description: Run-Command is a small run-dialog replacement from SoftwareOK. It is freeware; version 6.41 is current.

name: RustDesk
description: Open-source remote desktop tool (AGPLv3) that works out of the box or against a self-hosted server, as a TeamViewer alternative.
free_enough_reason: a paid Pro server exists, but the free self-hosted server and the free client cover remote desktop fully.

name: Sandboxie Plus
description: Sandboxing tool that runs applications in isolated containers so they cannot change the system. Base features are GPLv3 and free for personal use; a paid supporter certificate adds extra features.
free_enough_reason: a paid supporter certificate adds extra features, but the free base features sandbox applications fully.

name: Scribus
description: Scribus is a desktop publishing application for page layout and print-ready documents. It is released under the GPL.

name: SeaMonkey
description: Community-maintained internet suite with a browser, email client, HTML editor and IRC chat, under the MPL license.

name: SimpleWall
description: Lightweight firewall frontend configuring the Windows Filtering Platform to control network activity per application. For advanced users; free and open source.

name: Spybot - Search & Destroy
description: Spyware detection and removal tool. The free edition is complete; paid editions add scheduled automation.
free_enough_reason: paid editions add scheduled automation, but the free edition detects and removes spyware without limits.

name: SSD-Z
description: Freeware SSD information tool that reports drive model, firmware, S.M.A.R.T. attributes and controller details. Latest release is the 16.09.09b beta from 2016.
notes: UNCERTAIN: official site aezay.dk appeared unreachable during verification; could not confirm a current official download URL. Free for personal and business use per the author's license.

name: StackNotes
description: StackNotes is a desktop sticky-notes application distributed as open source. SourceForge lists it as Public Domain while PortableApps lists a FreeBSD license.

name: Startup Sentinel
description: Freeware startup manager by KC Softwares that watches for programs adding themselves to autostart and lets you approve, reject or blacklist them. It is a self-contained local tool with no paid tier or upsells.
notes: KC Softwares shut down in Oct 2023 and declared all products EOL, but this local tool needs no online service and remains functional; the official site now shows the termination notice. PortableApps packages the latest 1.9.0.28 with the publisher's permission.

name: Stickies
description: Stickies is a lightweight sticky-notes application from Zhorn Software. It is freeware for personal and business use; version 10.2a released Jan 2025.

name: StressMyPC
description: Freeware stress tester by SoftwareOK that loads the CPU, GPU and hard drive to test system stability and laptop battery endurance. Actively maintained (v5.88, May 2026).

name: Syncthing
description: Syncthing is a continuous file synchronization program that syncs files between devices. It is released under the MPL-2.0.

name: System Informer
description: Open source task and system manager (GPL-3.0), formerly Process Hacker, for deep monitoring of processes, services, drivers and network activity. Actively developed.

name: Task Coach
description: Task Coach is a to-do manager with hierarchical tasks, effort tracking and reminders. It is released under the GPL-3.0 and remains actively developed.

name: TCPView
description: Sysinternals utility listing all TCP and UDP endpoints on the system with the owning process. The download includes the Tcpvcon command-line version.

name: TeamViewer
description: Remote access and support tool. Free for personal, non-commercial use; commercial use needs a paid license.
notes: free tier covers personal use only; TeamViewer states sessions that appear commercial get flagged.

name: TinyTask
description: Tiny macro recorder from Vista Software. Records mouse and keyboard input and replays it; the portable executable is 36 KB.
notes: voluntary donations only; no paid tier or feature gating reported.

name: Tor Browser
description: Web browser that routes traffic through the Tor network for anonymous browsing. Free and open source; donations fund development.

name: Toucan
description: Toucan is a file synchronization, backup and encryption utility. It is released under the GPLv2 and maintained by PortableApps; version 3.1.8.2 is current.
notes: UNCERTAIN: the exact PortableApps app-page URL was not captured verbatim, so the PortableApps.com domain root is used.

name: Transmission
description: Lightweight BitTorrent client for Windows, macOS and Linux with a minimal interface.

name: TreeSize Free
description: TreeSize Free scans drives and folders to show disk space usage. It is freeware and the free edition is a complete product.
free_enough_reason: The free edition fully scans and reports disk usage; paid editions add export, scheduling and enterprise features.
notes: UNCERTAIN: JAM's own FAQ allows commercial use but a JAM marketing PDF says personal non-commercial only — conflict unresolved; personal_use set to false per the FAQ.

name: Trelix Stinger
description: Portable scanner that detects and removes specific prevalent malware and fake-alert threats.
notes: could not verify the direct Stinger download page on trellix.com.

name: uGet
description: Download manager for Windows, Linux and Android. The Windows build is ad-free; the Android version shows ads, which does not affect the Windows build.

name: UNetbootin
description: Open source tool that creates bootable USB drives for Linux distributions. It is GPL-2.0-or-later licensed; the latest stable release (702) dates from Feb 2021 but it remains functional.

name: Ventoy
description: Open source tool that turns a USB drive into a multiboot device by simply copying ISO files onto it, with no reformatting. It is GPL-3.0-or-later licensed.
notes: Wikipedia notes parts of the project ecosystem are only partially open source; the core tool is GPL-3.0-or-later.

name: VeraCrypt
description: Disk and partition encryption tool forked from TrueCrypt, under the VeraCrypt license.

name: Virtual Magnifying Glass
description: Open source screen magnifier that shows a zoomed view of the area under the mouse cursor in a floating window. It works on any application without installation.
notes: GPL-2.0 licensed project on SourceForge.

name: Virtual Volumes View
description: Virtual Volumes View catalogs offline media and archives so they can be searched later. It is released under the GPL; version 1.5 released Jan 2024.

name: VMMap
description: Freeware Sysinternals tool that breaks down a process's virtual and physical memory by type, such as heap, stack, image and mapped files. Useful for finding memory leaks.

name: WackGet
description: Download manager and accelerator. The original MillWeed site is offline; builds are distributed via PortableApps.com.
notes: original site offline; could not verify an official download page.

name: WhatChanged
description: Freeware tool by Vista Software that scans the registry and file system for changes between two snapshots. Latest release is from 2010; unmaintained but functional, free for personal and business use.
notes: Developer site no longer offers the download; PortableApps is the working source.

name: WhoDat
description: Simple WHOIS lookup utility for domain and IP registration records.
notes: last release 0.9 (2013); could not verify an active developer site; distributed via PortableApps.com; UNCERTAIN whether it works on Windows 11.

name: WhyNotWin11
description: Open source (LGPL-3.0) detection tool that checks which Windows 11 requirements a PC fails, such as TPM, Secure Boot, CPU generation and storage. It runs as a single executable with no ads.

name: WinCDEmu
description: Open source virtual disc tool that mounts ISO, CUE, NRG and other image files as virtual CD and DVD drives. It is LGPL-3.0 licensed; unmaintained since 2015 but functional.

name: WinContig
description: Freeware defragmenter by Marco D'Amato that defragments individual files or folders instead of whole disks. It is free for personal and business use with no ads or upsells.

name: WinDirStat
description: WinDirStat is a disk usage statistics viewer with a treemap display. It is released under the GPLv2; version 2.8.0 released Aug 2026.

name: Windows Error Lookup Tool
description: Open source (GPL-3.0) error code lookup tool that translates Windows, NTSTATUS, DirectX and STOP codes into readable descriptions. It is portable and actively maintained.
notes: UNCERTAIN: the row name matches 'Windows Error Lookup Tool' by Gunners Software (freeware, unmaintained since v3.0.7 in 2013); this verdict covers the distinct, actively maintained 'Error Lookup' by Henry++, which fits the row's description.

name: WinFile
description: WinFile is the classic Windows File Manager, open-sourced by Microsoft. It is released under the MIT license.

name: WinMTR
description: Visual Windows port of MTR combining ping and traceroute in one tool, released under the GPLv2. Barely maintained but still functional.

name: WinObj
description: Freeware Sysinternals viewer for the NT Object Manager namespace, showing devices, drivers, symbolic links and other kernel objects. It is the definitive tool for exploring the object directory.

name: WinSCP
description: SFTP, FTP, SCP and WebDAV client for Windows, released under the GPL.

name: WinWGet
description: Windows GUI front end for the GNU Wget downloader, released under the GPLv2.
notes: could not verify the developer's download page; the WinWGet+ fork is closed-source freeware and is a different project.

name: WireGuard
description: Official Windows client for the WireGuard VPN protocol. The client is free and open source; you supply the VPN server configuration.

name: Wise Disk Cleaner
description: Freeware junk-file cleaner by WiseCleaner that removes temporary files, browser traces and other clutter to free disk space. The official site states the free edition is completely free with lifetime updates.

name: Wise Duplicate Finder
description: Wise Duplicate Finder finds and removes duplicate files on a drive. It is freeware.
free_enough_reason: The free version fully searches for and deletes duplicate files; only the automatic 'Keep One' option requires the Pro version.

name: Wise Force Deleter
description: Wise Force Deleter deletes files locked by other processes. It is completely free with no paid tier.

name: Wise JetSearch
description: Wise JetSearch is a file search tool from WiseCleaner. It is freeware.

name: Wise Program Uninstaller
description: Freeware uninstaller by WiseCleaner that removes desktop programs, Windows apps and browser extensions, with force uninstall for broken entries.
free_enough_reason: The free edition is a complete uninstaller with leftover cleanup, force uninstall and no ads, per TechRadar and Gizmodo reviews.
notes: UNCERTAIN: third-party pages (an IObit comparison, coupon listings) reference a newer paid Pro tier (~$9.97/yr) adding deeper leftover scanning and support; could not verify its feature split on the official site.

name: Wise Registry Cleaner
description: Freeware registry cleaner by WiseCleaner that scans for invalid entries, backs up changes before cleaning and defragments the registry.
free_enough_reason: The free edition is a complete registry cleaner; Pro adds multi-user scanning and priority support.
notes: UNCERTAIN: the product page URL could not be captured verbatim, so the official homepage is used above. Could not verify whether the free edition shows Pro upgrade prompts.

name: WizFile
description: WizFile is a disk search utility from Antibody Software. It is freeware; personal use is free while commercial use requires a Supporter or Enterprise license.

name: WizTree
description: WizTree is a disk space analyzer that scans drives quickly. It is freeware, free for personal use only; commercial use requires a paid license.

name: Yubico Authenticator
description: Desktop app that generates one-time passcodes from a YubiKey hardware key. Open source; requires a YubiKey.
notes: requires a YubiKey hardware key; could not verify the exact OSI license from search results.

name: YUMI exFAT
description: Open source multiboot USB creator (GPL) for exFAT-formatted drives that boots multiple operating systems from one USB stick. Latest release v1.0.2.4 (Oct 2023).

name: YUMI Legacy
description: Open source multiboot USB creator (GPL-2.0) that installs multiple Linux distributions and tools on one drive. Archived at v2.0.9.4 (Jan 2022); the publisher recommends the exFAT variant for current use.

name: YUMI UEFI
description: Open source multiboot USB creator (GPL-2.0) with UEFI support. It remains an archived preview at v0.0.4.5 (Mar 2022).

name: Zettlr
description: Open-source (GPL-3.0) Markdown editor for researchers and note-takers with citation support, Zettelkasten knowledge management and exports via Pandoc and LaTeX.
notes: Donations requested on the site; all features work without donating.

name: Zim
description: Desktop personal wiki (GPL-2.0-or-later) keeping notes as plain-text wiki pages in a folder structure, with linking, plugins, task list and equation editor. Actively released (0.77.0, June 2026).
notes: URL scheme (https) assumed for zim-wiki.org; could not verify canonical scheme. Windows builds support 64-bit Windows 10 only.
